works.title: The Douay-Rheims Bible
works.note: Challoner's revision (1749-1752) of the Douay (1609-10) and Rheims (1582) translations, 73 books. #1581, not #8300: #8300's own front matter points to #1581 as the improved and more complete edition.

works.title: World English Bible (with the Deuterocanon)
works.licence: https://ebible.org/find/details.php?id=engwebu (also copr.htm in engwebu_usfm.zip): "The World English Bible is in the Public Domain. That means that it is not copyrighted. However, \"World English Bible\" is a Trademark of eBible.org. [...] All we ask is that if you CHANGE the actual text of the World English Bible in any way, you not call the result the World English Bible any more. [...] we who have worked on this translation freely give it to you by dedicating it to the Public Domain."
works.note: eBible engwebu: the WEB with "LORD" for the divine name (eng-web, the same text with "Yahweh", is a one-line switch); 81 books with the Deuterocanon and the WEB glossary; the preface (FRT) is skipped. Text unchanged, so the WEB name may be used.

works.title: Berean Standard Bible
works.licence: https://berean.bible/terms.htm: "The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially dedicated to the public domain as of April 30, 2023. All uses are freely permitted." https://ebible.org/find/details.php?id=engbsb: "Berean Standard Bible ... Public Domain"
works.note: eBible engbsb: 66 books. First published 2016 as the Berean Study Bible; this is the current revised text. Text unchanged, so the Berean name may be used.

works.title: The Holy Scriptures (JPS 1917)
works.licence: https://ebible.org/find/details.php?id=engjps: "The Jewish Bible (Old Testament) in English, published by the Jewish Publication Society in 1917 ... Public Domain"
works.note: eBible engjps: 39 books of the Tanakh in the source's (Christian Old Testament) order; the source sets the Psalms as prose, so they have no verse lines.
